title: Combine style keywords in your Seedance 2.5 prompt like…
content:
Combine style keywords in your Seedance 2.5 prompt like 実写映画＋ヴィクトリアンゴシック＋ダークファンタジー＋シュルレアリスム＋キネティックタイポグラフィ to steer the video toward a gothic kinetic-typography music-video look  
Specify 3倍速 (3x speed) and ハイスピードMV in the prompt to push Seedance toward a fast-paced MV editing rhythm

en.content:
Combine style keywords in your Seedance 2.5 prompt like live-action film + Victorian gothic + dark fantasy + surrealism + kinetic typography to steer the video toward a gothic kinetic-typography music-video look

es.content:
